content: Human-labeling session — combat-flanking-attack:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement against a defensive enemy wall. You are given 8 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) split between two staging corridors — one far-north column (y=14-17) and one far-south column (y=23-26), depending on seed. A full-strength enemy wall sits across the centre at x=22-26 — 13 rocket infantry in two rows backed by 7 rifle infantry, on Defend orders. A water-walled funnel runs east-west through the centre. Open ground runs above the water (north) and below (south). Kill at least 5 enemies and keep at least 6 of 8 tanks alive within 3000 ticks.
